name: RSVP seat decision
purpose: Decide whether an RSVP holds a confirmed seat, joins the waitlist, or needs none. Send attending, party or seats, separated by spaces; it answers confirmed, waitlist or none, and invalid request for anything else.

promise.headline: Says conformant exactly when every policy file matches its lock.
promise.detail: Each of the six universal policy files is compared with the digest the lock records, and any file that drifted is named.

claim: RS-01: the app never answers confirmed when attending is no. RS-02: the app never answers confirmed when party is above seats.

proposition.name: judge
proposition.text:
judge request :=
  attending is no → none
  party equals 0 → none
  party is above seats → waitlist
  otherwise → confirmed
proposition.plain: Decide whether an RSVP holds a confirmed seat, joins the waitlist, or needs none.
